4Operating Revenue
4Q/2025
▪During this quarter, flooding in the southern region directly impacted the Hat Yai branch, however operating revenue still in creased + 1.2% YoY and + 5.9% 
QoQ, driven by both revenue from sales and revenue from rental.
▪Total sales continued to grow both YoY and QoQ, while the %GPM from sales also improved YoY due to the effective discount man agement across both 
retail store and online channels. While the %GPM from sales maintained QoQ.
▪Rental and services revenue increased YoY and QoQ, driven by the new branches added (Little Walk Rattanathibet  and Little Walk Ramkhamhaeng) as well 
as the full -year recognition of new rental space at the Chiang Mai branch after the renovation completed at the end of 2024 .
▪The %GPM from rental increased YoY and QoQ, mainly from an accounting reclassification was made whereby depreciation expenses  (Baht 19.1 million), 
previously recorded under cost of rental and services, were reclassified to SG&A expenses. Excluding this reclassification, g ross profits still increased both 
YoY and QoQ, while %GPM improved YoY but slightly dropped QoQ.
FY2025
▪Operating revenue slightly increased compared to the previous year.
▪Despite the flood and economic slowdown, the sales performance slightly increased. Growth mainly came from online sales and o verseas OEM orders. The 
%GPM also improved mainly from the effective discount management and a lower proportion of project sales.
▪Rental and services revenue increased + 6.6% YoY from the new branches opened during the year, including rental space after Chiang Mai branch 
renovation. The %GPM from rental also improved, supported by the lower average Ft (fuel tariff) electricity rate in 2025 , as well as the impact of the 
accounting reclassification. Excluding the impact of such adjustment, %GPM remained in line with the previous year.
(THB million)

7Selling & Administrative Expenses
(THB million, %)
Selling & Administrative Expenses
4Q/2025 SG&A expenses increased + 9.7% YoY and + 9.5% QoQ, while the ratio of SG&A expenses to operating revenue also increased, 
mainly due to:
➢The provision recognized in 4Q/2025 for flood -related damage at the Hat Yai branch (expect to receive compensation within 2026 
from insurance claims.)
➢SG&A expenses increased in line with the expansion in the number of branches.
➢Higher promotional expenses and online sales commissions corresponding to increased sales volume.
➢Excluding the impact of Hat Yai provision, the SG&A expenses to operating revenue ratio would decrease to 37.4%.
FY2025 SG&A expenses increased + 5.7% YoY, the ratio of SG&A expenses to operating revenue increased, due to:
➢The provision recognized for flood -related damage.
➢The SG&A expenses increased associated with branch expansion.
➢Higher promotional expenses and online sales commissions in line with increased sales.
➢IT system development investments.
➢Excluding the impact of Hat Yai provision, the SG&A expenses to operating revenue ratio would decrease to 37.0%.Quarterly Period Full Year Period
